forum.title: Missing line in clock tree in RM0394
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

This error has been introduced in revision 4 issued in 2018. Missing link from SYSCLK line shall go to line named SYSCLK:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/ad969d09-5b4e-486e-8dc9-7332295c87db.png)

That will be fixed when a new revision of the document is planned for release. As this product is considered as fully mature, the document will take a considerable time for update.
forum.content_text:
Can ST please fix [this](https://community.st.com/stm32-mcus-products-25/stm32l412-adc-clock-source-in-synchronous-clock-mode-166998?postid=744473#post744473) minor interconnection line missing in the RCC clock tree figure in RM0394.

JW
